title: Data center expansion has moved onto rural land: a global footprint analysis, 2017-2026 (code and campus dataset)
description:
Code and campus-level dataset for a global analysis of the land taken by data center campuses. 2,378 campuses mapped in OpenStreetMap across 101 countries are read against Esri/Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover (2017-2023), GHSL 2020 population and settlement data, and Sentinel-2 imagery from 2023 and 2026. The dataset gives, for each campus, its footprint, status (built before 2017, built 2018-2023, or unbuilt in 2023), annual built share, hectares converted from cropland, trees, rangeland and bare land, settlement type, residents within 5 km, and Sentinel-2 change measures. A preprint manuscript (not peer reviewed) is included in paper/manuscript.md.

Campus data are derived from OpenStreetMap and released under the Open Database License; code is MIT.
